profile_name: Rigid block movement ON (measured for speed; strength UNGATED)
description: Moves a unit as one rigid block before falling back to per-model placement — every model translates by the same vector and the attempt is abandoned the moment one destination is illegal, which is the player's drag-select-and-drag. Suggested by the project owner after two 2000-pt Ork games failed to leave BATTLE ROUND 1 in 22 minutes. Speed is measured; STRENGTH IS NOT, so this ships disabled until run_paired + gate_candidate say otherwise.
